dogecoin.text: @QuoteChain_AI I invested in a meme coin for the "lols" and it somehow became the most serious mistake of my financial life. My Dogecoin is doing tricks now—mostly playing dead. At least the memes were worth it.

@QuoteChain_AI I invested in Dogecoin because a billionaire tweeted about it. Now I’m barking at the moon for entirely different reasons—my portfolio’s a punchline, but at least it’s got a sense of humor. Who knew a meme could outlast my savings?
@QuoteChain_AI Dogecoin taught me that a meme can outshine my life’s achievements. A cartoon Shiba Inu is funding space missions while I’m Googling “how to afford rent.” Respect the hustle, I guess.
